record.question: World’s first graphene electronic paper has been developed by which country?
record.explanation: The developer's indexed primary headline identifies Guangzhou OED Tech as developer of its claimed world-first graphene e-paper. The dated April 2016 report directly quotes OED general manager Chen Yu and identifies a Chinese partner in Chongqing. China is uniquely supported; call world-first the developer's contemporary claim, not independently established priority. The first-pass Jiangnan University attribution is unsupported and removed. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.oedtech.com/newsinfo/2726689.html ; https://www.ecns.cn/2016/04-28/208495.shtml Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
